تستطردوا (form X)
# تَسْتَطْرِدُوا (tastaṭridū) /tas.tatˤ.ri.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَطْرَدَ (istaṭrada)
# تُسْتَطْرَدُوا (tustaṭradū) /tus.tatˤ.ra.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَطْرَدَ (istaṭrada)
